finding: Lane-owned claim renewals can fail with an actor-vs-same-actor `ATM_TASK_CLAIM_OWNER_MISMATCH` because the effective mismatch is lane-session identity, not actor identity.
expectedBehavior: When `ownershipMode` is `lane-id`, the error code and message should name lane-vs-lane mismatch, and an expired `ATM_LANE_SESSION_ID` fallback should either adopt/rebind explicitly or fail with the adopt command before minting a competing lane.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0245 renew failed with currentActor and actorId both `codex-git-series-captain`, holding lane `lane-20260729225909-...`, requested lane `lane-20260730011541-...`, and `ownershipMode: lane-id`. Running `lane adopt` then renew succeeded.
followUp: Split lane mismatch from actor mismatch, add stale-lane env fallback semantics, and persist adoption so subsequent CLI invocations do not silently mint a new lane.
